item.title: From chaos to cruise control: Generative AI and the next era of human-centric warehouse management
item.description: Managing a warehouse today can feel a lot like going on a beach vacation without a plan. You’ve packed your suitcase, brought sunscreen, and maybe even remembered the snacks, but the tides and the long lines at the rental shop all catch you off guard. Traditional warehouse management systems (WMS) can feel the same way.

item.title: Lifeway Foods launches Power Play shake at Barry's Fuel Bar locations
item.description: The Lifeway Power Play shake blends Organic Plain Whole Milk Kefir, blue spirulina, chia seeds, almond milk, vanilla whey protein, granola, and blueberries, providing a protein- and probiotic-packed boost to energize workouts and support recovery.

item.title: Hain Celestial sells snacks business to focus on yogurt and other brands
item.description: Company owns Greek Gods yogurt brand.

item.title: Sargento introduces two new portfolio lines
item.description: Sargento announced it has expanded its natural cheese lineup with two new product lines: Sargento Hot & Spicy Sliced Cheeses and Sargento Balanced Breaks Cheese + Crunch Mixes.

item.title: Kraft Natural Cheese debuts Protein Cheese Sticks
item.description: Available in two classic varieties — Mild Cheddar and Pepper Jack— each stick delivers 17 grams of protein per serving and contains 50% less fat than Kraft Natural Cheese’s traditional Mild Cheddar and Pepper Jack Cheese varieties.

item.title: Episode 61 — What the future holds for A2 milk
item.description: Jeff Mroz, co-founder of Pioneer Pastures, joins Dairy Foods for Episode 61 of the “Let’s Talk Dairy” podcast. He discusses A2 milk and his company.

item.title: ORBIS acquires Robinson Industries
item.description: Founded in the 1940s and headquartered in Coleman, Mich., Robinson Industries brings decades of thermoforming expertise, including single and twin-sheet thermoforming, sheet extrusion and structural foam injection molding.

item.title: Dairy membrane market gaining momentum as processors invest in advanced filtration
item.description: Market forecasts for 2026 show continued growth in membrane use for dairy product separation, quality and efficiency.

item.title: NOSHOK names Buchanan Midwest regional sales manager
item.description: Buchanan brings more than 30 years of proven sales leadership and territory management experience in industrial manufacturing, motion control, and safety solutions, with a strong track record of driving year-over-year growth and building strategic customer relationships.

item.title: RITZ to premiere star-studded big game ad
item.description: The :30 second commercial opens with Hamm and Yang perched in a treehouse overlooking partygoers who are enjoying RITZ Crackers on the beach.
